The team enlist the aid of their very own tartan army to tackle this build and try to help get this family back on track.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.desc: S23 E5 — Dudley Nick Knowles and the team join forces with an army of local tradespeople to come to the aid of a family in Dudley. All three children in the Whitehouse family have an inherited condition called Fragile X Syndrome. The symptoms vary, but their youngest son has been hit hardest and has learning difficulties. Dad Wayne and mum Joanne attempted to build an extension to their house to try and cope.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
